meta.title: Matching the best price in an auction is allowed unless the round forbids ties
gaps: No setup recipe creates an auction with QA vendor 1 already having a bid.
No operation can invite QA vendor 1 to an auction or configure whether tie bids are allowed or forbidden.
The bid read-back shape does not expose a price field, so QA vendor 2's bid cannot be set dynamically to exactly QA vendor 1's price.
The conditional outcomes (accepted when ties are allowed versus refused when ties are forbidden) cannot be represented in one plan.
